name: Keen Launch
description: Level the shaft at the shoulder and release it in a clean line toward the mark.

name: Cruel Leadknob
description: Reverse the grip and thrust the shaft back-handed at a foe pressing close behind.

name: Plumezip
description: Leap forward off the back foot to cover the last paces before the release.

name: Sturdy Lightshaft
description: Check a stab with the middle of the shaft and slide it off to the side.

name: Dartflog
description: Feed qi down the arm into the release so the shaft flies fast and flat.

name: Grim Skewerflight
description: Thicken qi at the point of the shaft so that it pierces the rim of a shield.

name: Patient Pointbalance
description: Draw a slow breath and gather warmth in the forearm before the throw begins.

name: Brisk Whistle
description: Snap the elbow forward for a short throw that leaves no time for a counter.

name: Rooted Dartcap
description: Plant the off foot hard and brace the shaft across the chest against a shoving shield.

name: Launchslap
description: Draw the spare javelin from the hip while the first is still in the air.

name: Fletchglide
description: Step back and turn the shoulder away so the opponent has a narrower target.

name: Rough Loft
description: Let the gathered qi go with the shaft in one burst that greatly adds to its speed.

name: Stubborn Thinheft
description: Spin the shaft before the body and let qi run along it to stop an incoming thrust.

name: Loftthwack
description: Widen the stance and heave the thick shaft with both legs and the back behind it.

name: Sure Tailweight
description: Twist a weighted shaft in the grip until the wrist holds firm against its pull.

name: Savage Dart
description: Lean the full weight behind a short throw aimed at the middle of a shield.

name: Leadscreen
description: Block a low cut with the shaft held at the waist and step in behind it.

name: Fierce Whistle
description: Back the heavy throw with qi so that the point cracks the boss of a hide shield.

name: Wild Skewerflight
description: Throw at the chest of a mounted man hard enough to lift him from the saddle.

name: Plumeglide
description: Kneel on one knee in a moving cart to lower the body's sway before the throw.

name: Ember Whistle
description: Release at the top of each roll of a deck so that the shaft leaves level.

name: Bold Loft
description: Lean into a slope and throw upward with a steeper wrist angle than on flat ground.

name: Gleamlaunch
description: Shorten the arm swing on a downhill throw so the shaft does not overshoot.

name: Darthurdle
description: Slide the lead foot over loose stones instead of lifting it to keep the body low and steady.

name: Regimen Thinheft
description: Hook an elbow over a rail or rope and brace the shaft against a boarding rush.

name: Sprout Leadknob
description: Sink qi into the legs so that the body stays still while the ground moves beneath it.

name: Cometlead
description: Read the motion of the footing and loose the shaft so qi carries it straight.

name: Brass Thinheft
description: Grip the shaft in both hands near its middle and thrust the point short and fast.

name: Poise Tailweight
description: Slide a hand up the shaft and sweep a stab wide with the stout part.

name: Loftzip
description: Slide back one pace while passing the shaft through the grip to keep the point forward.

name: Barbedswat
description: Turn both wrists at the end of a thrust and flick the point out sideways.

name: Sleet Dropdive
description: Throw the shaft in a full release only after close thrusts have opened a gap.

name: Honed Whistle
description: Run qi the whole length of the shaft as it thrusts so the point bites deeper.

name: Clay Pointbalance
description: Stand the shaft upright in both hands and charge it with qi to bar a descending axe.

name: Layered Dartpoint
description: Raise the shaft above the head at a slant to turn aside falling shafts or stones.

name: Static Skewerflight
description: Throw and turn the shoulder together so the body shows only its narrow side.

name: Mirage Throwloop
description: Begin a throw and stop short to draw a raised guard and open the line below.

name: Fletchcurl
description: Dash a few paces in a crouch to the nearest cover after the throw.

name: Draught Dart
description: Throw to graze the rim of a raised shield and drag it aside with qi on the shaft.

name: Barbedbuckle
description: Spin the retained shaft in a wheel of qi to bat away the answering throw.

name: Hum Launch
description: Throw at a hanging sandbag until its swing shows the force behind every shaft.

name: Dawn Tailweight
description: Haul a rope through a pulley from the hip to train the turn that drives a throw.

name: Launchstalk
description: Stand on one leg with the shaft raised to train balance at the instant of release.

name: Gall Fletch
description: Roll a shaft under the heel of a pursuer to trip them in mid-stride.

name: Prowling Leadknob
description: Vault a low barrier and throw just as the feet touch down.

name: Dartscorer
description: Throw five shafts in five breaths to build speed without losing the aim.

name: Purpose Thinheft
description: Pulse qi into the wrist on each release until the pulse and the snap arrive together.

name: Shard Skewerflight
description: Drive the point through a post at a set mark with qi packed behind the tip.

name: Plumeprop
description: Sweep the heavy arm back across the body after release to bat aside a close blow.

name: Loftswerve
description: Step half a pace off the line of an incoming shaft and let it pass the shoulder.

name: Haze Lightshaft
description: Slap the side of an incoming shaft with the open hand to turn its point away.

name: Resolute Fletch
description: Wheel the held shaft across the body to knock a thrown javelin out of its flight.

name: Leadthwack
description: Seize a spent shaft that lands at the feet and throw it straight back.

name: Candor Dartpoint
description: Watch the shoulder of the opposing thrower to read the moment of release.

name: Sprig Tailweight
description: Wrap a cloak round the forearm and let the shaft's point sink into the folds.

name: Ducking Barbed
description: Duck beneath a high shaft and roll forward to come up close to the thrower.

name: Armored Throwloop
description: Spread qi across the open palm to catch the flat of a shaft and kill its speed.

name: Launchflog
description: Turn a caught shaft in the hand and throw it back along the line it came.

name: Coasting Leadknob
description: Step toward an opposing thrower the instant they release and strike before they reload.
